name: qarunbook
description: A QA runbook your coding assistant can read and write. Testers raise what breaks; the assistant reads what failed, fixes it, and marks the issue resolved. Bundles the qarunbook MCP server and two skills: /test-checklist builds the plan from the code, /qa-runbook runs the testing.

interface.shortDescription: Read the QA runbook, fix what testers found, send it back for a retest.
interface.longDescription: qarunbook holds the test plan, the results per platform and the issues raised against them. This plugin connects Codex to your workspace over MCP and adds two skills: /test-checklist reads your code and drafts the plan, checks and all; /qa-runbook works through the plan, records each result with evidence and verifies fixes. Resolving an issue never passes a check: it reads as retest until a person looks again.
